title: Planning checks a guard's detector against the acceptor it guards, on planted variants, not only the clean form
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md (Sprints: plan) and the sprint skill say that an item adding a guard in front of an acceptor (a refusal keyed on a text the acceptor reads, such as kbdecide.py's ceiling guard in front of tests.py read_ceiling) carries a check that runs the acceptor's own predicate and the guard on planted variants (a prefix, a suffix, case), so a guard narrower than its acceptor fails before the start; a tested _self question leads rag.py pack --root _self to the rule
